meta.name: scienceworld-circuit-connector
meta.description: This skill connects two electrical components (e.g., wires, batteries, devices) by their terminals to build or modify a circuit. Use when constructing electrical setups for testing, such as conductivity checks or device activation. The input includes two component identifiers and their connection points, and the output is an established electrical connection.

copy.tagline: 连接电路元件构建测试回路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中搭建和测试电路。
copy.tagline_en: Connect circuit components to build test loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build and test circuits in a virtual environment.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能够连接两个电气元件的端子，例如将电池正极连到电线，从而构建或修改电路，用于测试导电性或设备运行。
howto.when: 当你要测试材料电导率、连接电源到负载（灯泡、蜂鸣器等），或集成开关传感器时触发。

say.text: 把电池正极连接到红色电线端子1。
连接未知物质M的端子A到灯泡的端子2。
测试铁棒导电性：电池负极连铁棒一端，铁棒另一端连灯泡。

howto.what_en: Claude can connect terminals of two electrical components (e.g., battery to wire) to build or modify a circuit for testing conductivity or device operation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to establish a circuit connection, such as testing material conductivity, connecting a power source to a load, or integrating a switch/sensor.

say_en.text: Connect the battery anode to terminal 1 of the red wire.
Connect terminal A of unknown substance M to terminal 2 of the light bulb.
Test iron rod conductivity: connect battery cathode to one end of rod, other end to bulb.
